summary: Comprehensive testing of RFQ Auth Gate (WhatsApp OTP flow) per May 2026 spec. All 10 test scenarios pass. Backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend auth gate renders properly for guests on both mobile (/m/rfq) and desktop (/rfq). Logged-in users with complete profiles see the RFQ form directly. PDP-launched RFQs show locked specs card with Edit toggle. Incomplete profiles (phone-only signup) correctly land on registration stage.

ui_bugs.issue: Composition displays as '[object Object]' instead of formatted string (e.g., 'Cotton 100%')

action_items: Fix composition display in MRFQ.js line 148 - currently shows [object Object] instead of formatted composition string
critical_code_review_comments: RFQAuthGate.js correctly implements 3-stage flow (phone → otp → register)
Profile completeness check correctly identifies placeholder emails (@phone.locofast.local)
MRFQ.js correctly handles PDP context with fabric param and Edit toggle
Backend WhatsApp OTP endpoints working with proper rate limiting and validation
GST verification via Sandbox API working correctly on profile update

test_credentials.test_phone_otp: Any 10-digit phone, OTP from db.customer_otps (latest unused for that phone)

seed_data_creation: Created test customers via WhatsApp OTP flow during testing. All test data uses unique phone numbers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RFQ Auth Gate fully tested. Key localStorage keys: 'lf_customer_token' (JWT), 'lf_customer' (customer object). Profile completeness requires: name truthy, email NOT ending in '@phone.locofast.local', gstin truthy. WhatsApp OTP rate limit: 3 per phone per 10 minutes.

guest_mobile_rfq_auth_gate.details: /m/rfq shows auth gate with phone input and Send OTP button for guests

guest_desktop_rfq_auth_gate.details: /rfq shows auth gate, RFQ page content hidden behind gate

verify_whatsapp_otp_invalid.details: POST /api/customer/verify-whatsapp-otp with wrong OTP returns 400 'Invalid or expired OTP'

full_otp_flow.details: send-otp → read from db.customer_otps → verify-otp → returns {token, customer, is_new}

profile_update_with_gst.details: PUT /api/customer/profile with valid GSTIN returns 200, gst_verified=true, company auto-filled

logged_in_header_launched_rfq.details: /m/rfq with complete profile shows fabric picker grid, no locked specs card

logged_in_pdp_launched_rfq.details: /m/rfq?fabric=<slug> shows locked specs card with Edit button

pdp_edit_toggle.details: Clicking Edit shows fabric picker with 'Use specs from' revert button

incomplete_profile_register_stage.details: Phone-only customer (placeholder email) lands on register stage, not OTP screen

shared_cart_regression.details: /shared-cart/<token> loads without crash (shows 'Cart Unavailable' for invalid token)
